name: Global Uniques
uniques: Requires establishing embassies to conduct advanced diplomacy
[+15]% [Gold] from [Trade Routes] [in all cities] <when at [Golden Age]>
Nullifies All Yield <while is in resistance>
Great People can be hired for [Gold] [in all cities] <when at war>
Can spend [Diplomatic Favor] to increase [World Congress] voting weight
Emergency Aid provides [+10] [Diplomatic Favor] when helping [City-State]
World Congress resolutions grant [Diplomatic Favor] based on participation

civilopediaText.text: Global uniques are ruleset-wide modifiers that apply to all civilizations.
